components.title: Swap two slots
components.summary_md: Exchange the values at two indices and return the array. Every in-place algorithm starts here.

build_steps.title: Predict the swap
build_steps.prompt_md: Read the snippet and predict its output before running anything.

payload.question: What does this print?
payload.explanation_md: The right-hand side is evaluated first, so both values are read before either slot is written.

build_steps.title: Build swapAt
build_steps.prompt_md: Implement `swapAt(a, i, j)`: swap `a[i]` and `a[j]` in place and return `a`.

starter_code.python:
def swapAt(a, i, j):
    return a

tests.explain_on_fail: Swapping an index with itself must leave the array unchanged.

hints.body_md: You need somewhere to keep one value while you overwrite its slot.
Copy `a[i]` into a temporary, move `a[j]` into `a[i]`, then the temporary into `a[j]`.

components.title: Sift down
components.summary_md: Restore the max-heap property below index `i` by swapping the node with its larger child until it settles.

build_steps.title: Build siftDown
build_steps.prompt_md: Implement `siftDown(a, i)` for a max-heap stored in an array. Call your `swapAt` from the prelude.

tests.explain_on_fail: Keep sifting until the node is at least as large as both children or has none.

hints.body_md: The children of index `i` live at `2i + 1` and `2i + 2`.
Pick the larger child. If it beats the node, swap and continue from the child's index.
